text:
maya: Quick sync — region expansion status. Targeting APAC (sg) canary start 2026-04-16, full prod 2026-04-20. EU-lon canary 2026-04-23. Blocking items: KMS key for SG, final routing-policy PR, and cloud provider egress firewall exceptions. Tagging infra/security/legal for ownership.

liam: Infra update — VPCs and subnets provisioned in ap-southeast-1 and eu-west-2. VPN & peering tested. KMS request filed (ticket INF-1882) — waiting for security approval. I'll open the routing PR (4321) tonight for review.

sophia: Routing notes — draft policy at https://rwd.internal/notes/region-routing (private). Default failover order: local -> regional -> global. Need to decide on cost-tier cutoff (e.g., route to cheaper model variant when >100ms). Also propose a canary weight schedule: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 72h.

nate: Legal/security — Data residency questionnaire filled, but we need confirmation on logs/metrics retention for EU customers. Our standard is 90d; is that acceptable? Also confirming that audit logs are stored within customer region when requested.

clare: Logs/ops — 90 days default for EU, can be shortened per contract. We do keep control plane audit logs in region when `data_residency=regional` is set, but some third-party metrics (pagerduty, hosted-saas) may remain in US unless routed through regional proxies. Need to add a note in the enterprise onboarding flow.

devops-bot: dns-updater: CNAME created for sg canary -> canary-sg.rwd-inference.net

liam: Ping for reviews @sophia @yun — PR 4321 (routing + canary hooks) ready. Also PR 4322 adds region-specific KMS key usage in terraform.

yun: I'll take PR 4321 first pass tonight, focus on traffic weighting and ttl behavior.

sophia: Reviewing now. A couple of nit comments on the fallback logic. Also add `SSE-KMS` enforcement for EU buckets (s3 encryption).

maya: Milestone check — if KMS + PR reviews clear within 48h and cloud egress exceptions approved, we can start sg canary on 4/16. Can everyone drop blockers here by EOD tomorrow?

nate: Security update — KMS approval queued, expected 24-36h. Filing security approval thread: https://rwd.internal/secure/INF-1882.

clare: Added onboarding note and updated enterprise template to call out regional audit logs.

liam: Quick test command for devs: ```REWRITE_ROUTES=1 ./infra/deploy.sh --region=ap-southeast-1 --env=canary``` Use it to validate local routing changes.

sophia: One more ops caveat — S3 bucket names must be globally unique; recommend we prefix with `rwd-eu-<team>-<env>` to avoid accidental creation in wrong region.

maya: Great. I'll update the roadmap and send a short status to execs after we have the KMS confirmation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

liam: ack. I'll post a follow-up here once PRs merge.

yun: Review done, left 3 tiny comments. No blockers from networking side.

clare: :thumbsup:
